related.title: TAT-8：海纜再生區段與設備數量
related.titleEn: TAT-8: submarine regeneration spans and equipment count
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學鏈路可用5 Gbit/s；4路通過、8路不足；另外檢查時序與抖動，不以平均位元率代替確定延遲。 iq_payload.csv、功能分割圖與鏈路預算 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 3.6 與變更 7.2 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching available link5 Gbit/s:4 streams pass and8 fail; timing/jitter must be checked separately from mean rate. iq_payload.csv, functional-split diagram and link budget Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 3.6 and changed 7.2 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 每一區段均不得超過假設上限，端點恰有兩個；數量減少不等於已證明供電、OSNR或可靠度合格。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Every span must satisfy its assumed limit and there must be exactly two shore endpoints; fewer units do not establish power-feed, OSNR or reliability compliance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成4路、30e6 samples/s、I與Q各12 bits、有效比例0.8；變更8路。 名義式 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s；變更式 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在1 ms窗逐流算IQ bytes再除時間；用封包總位元/負載位元反推0.8，不重複加入協定開銷。

合成線路6200 km，區段上限50 km；比較上限60 km，採均勻配置。 名義式 ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units；變更式 ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用設備數加一反推平均區段長，再逐段加總到6200 km；103台時104區段約59.615 km。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic4 streams,30e6 samples/s,12 bits each forI andQ and0.8 efficiency; change to8 streams. Nominal 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s; changed 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count IQ bytes per stream in a1 ms window and divide by time; recover0.8 from packet/payload counts without adding overhead twice.

Synthetic6200 km route, maximum span50 km; compare60 km with uniform placement. Nominal ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units; changed ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recover mean span from units plus one, then sum all spans to6200 km;103 internal units imply104 spans of about59.615 km.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: INDIGO：開放光纜頻譜的連續區塊配置
related.titleEn: INDIGO: contiguous allocation in open-cable spectrum
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學鏈路可用5 Gbit/s；4路通過、8路不足；另外檢查時序與抖動，不以平均位元率代替確定延遲。 iq_payload.csv、功能分割圖與鏈路預算 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 3.6 與變更 7.2 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching available link5 Gbit/s:4 streams pass and8 fail; timing/jitter must be checked separately from mean rate. iq_payload.csv, functional-split diagram and link budget Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 3.6 and changed 7.2 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 最大空閒段減需求需非負且保護槽已包含在需求；原配置失敗、整理後通過，遷移中斷另行評估。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Largest free run minus request must be nonnegative with guards already included; original fails and compaction passes, with migration interruption separately evaluated.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成4路、30e6 samples/s、I與Q各12 bits、有效比例0.8；變更8路。 名義式 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s；變更式 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在1 ms窗逐流算IQ bytes再除時間；用封包總位元/負載位元反推0.8，不重複加入協定開銷。
合成空閒區塊長度2、3、2槽，新通道需4槽；整理後區塊1、6槽，總空閒均7槽。 名義式 max(max(2,3),2)-4 = -1 slots；變更式 max(1,6)-4 = 2 slots。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 畫逐槽占用位元圖逐一滑動4槽窗，核對原圖無可用窗而整理後有3個起點；所有既有通道寬度需守恆。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic4 streams,30e6 samples/s,12 bits each forI andQ and0.8 efficiency; change to8 streams. Nominal 4*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 3.6 Gbit/s; changed 8*30e6*2*12/0.8/1e9 = 7.2 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count IQ bytes per stream in a1 ms window and divide by time; recover0.8 from packet/payload counts without adding overhead twice.

Synthetic free runs of2,3,2 slots with a four-slot request; compact to runs1,6, preserving seven free slots. Nominal max(max(2,3),2)-4 = -1 slots; changed max(1,6)-4 = 2 slots. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Scan a four-slot window across a slot bitmap; the original has no placement and the compacted six-slot run has three start positions; conserve existing widths.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
